name: Wild West
source:
In this wonderful game you have to plunge into the history of the wild west in which two hot lesbians are waiting for you. Page just sat and got bored, but then her best friend came and it started...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118610/Wild_West/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这款精彩的游戏里，你将投身狂野西部的历史，那里有两位火辣的女同性恋者正等着你。佩姬本来只是坐着发闷，后来她最好的朋友来了，一切就这样开始了…
